notes: Continued user-approved retouch-and-publish workflow. Work two at a time; checkpoint each pair and push after eight. Preserve original photos and link them from live AI-labelled cards. Exact fine engraving remains unverified.

entries.review: Silver/pale-champagne finish and white background improved. Main circuit-brain/open-circle, text-panel and shield layout visually retained. Exact trace/terminal counts, tiny shield details and inscription glyphs remain unverified.
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: an actual commemorative euro coin photograph for an online catalogue. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target. Images 2 and 3 are finish references only. Change only the photographed surface colour, blotchy dirt and background: clean neutral satin-silver outer ring, VERY PALE low-saturation cream-beige champagne-gold centre, pure white background, matching the references. Keep the same photographed coin, orientation, outline, relief shading and modest white margin. Preserve EVERY original engraved line and shape, all inscriptions/accents/spacing, dates, mint marks, initials, and all twelve stars EXACTLY as in Image 1. Follow visible source edges; do not reconstruct or guess tiny unreadable details. No redrawing, new lettering, simplified geometry, extra symbols or invented relief. Do not copy a motif from the finish references. One coin only, no collage; avoid saturated yellow, dark gold and mirror chrome. Target: Slovakia 2020 OECD accession anniversary. Lock the exact circuit-board/brain outline, every branching trace, circular terminal and connection, the central open circle, the geometric text panel and small Slovak shield. Preserve all source Slovak wording, OECD, SLOVENSKO, 2020, accents and mint/designer marks exactly. No regularized or invented circuit paths.
